Definition: to crawl; by implication, to fear
BiblicalUsage: zâchal means to crawl. In Deuteronomy 32:24 we read, "They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction..." It appears again in Job 32:6: "And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid..."
TheologicalSignificance: zachal is to crawl, and I believe no word in Scripture is wasted, so this one earns its place.
